title: Backend Software Developer
description:
Backend Software Developer – Maatwerk Software met Impact

Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij.

Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Binnen onze Smart Devices afdeling bouwen we apps die impact maken. Van media apps voor bedrijven als Pathé en de NPO met miljoenen gebruikers, tot de app van het KNMI waarmee we belangrijke weerswaarschuwingen zoals code rood meldingen afgeven. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details.

Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Backend Software Developer. Iemand die energie krijgt van het ontwikkelen van sterke backend-omgevingen, het schrijven van strakke code en het operationeel krijgen én houden van de onderliggende cloud-infrastructuur voor applicaties met miljoenen gebruikers.

Jouw rol

Als Backend Software Developer ben je een onmisbare schakel in de backend-trajecten van onze applicaties. Je bouwt de schaalbare, onzichtbare motor achter hoogwaardige innovaties en zorgt dat onze infrastructuur robuust staat. Je bent analytisch sterk en je krijgt er energie van om technische requirements te vertalen naar logische cloud-infrastructuren die je vervolgens zélf bouwt. Je werkt nauw samen met onze multidisciplinaire ontwikkelteams en zorgt dat de code soepel draait. Geen haastwerk, maar engineering met diepgang en visie.

Wat je zal gaan doen:

  • Ontwikkelen en operationeel maken van serverless backends en event-driven API's met TypeScript (AWS Lambda / Serverless Functions).

  • Zelfstandig opzetten van cloud-infrastructuren met behulp van Infrastructure as Code (bijv. via AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation).

  • Proactief meedenken over en het inrichten van CI/CD pipelines, applicatie-uptime en databeveiliging.

  • Bijdragen aan de codekwaliteit door middel van code reviews en het actief delen van kennis met jouw teamleden.

  • Effectief asynchroon samenwerken, documenteren en code opleveren binnen een distributed, remote-first team.


Wie ben jij?

We zoeken een developer met een HBO werk- en denkniveau die al de nodige stappen heeft gezet in het bouwen van cloud-native applicaties. Je hebt sterke ervaring met de TypeScript/Node.js stack en modern software-development zoals Agile/Scrum, CI/CD en Infrastructure as Code kent voor jou geen geheimen.

Je bent niet alleen een developer, maar je kunt ook écht zelf cloudomgevingen operationeel krijgen en beheren met tools als AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation. Algemene cloud kennis is een vereiste; specifieke ervaring met AWS of Scaleway is een pre. Je geniet van technische puzzels, levert graag goed geteste code op en voelt je thuis in een Node.js backend. Verder ben je woonachtig in Nederland.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • De Organisatie: Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software.

  • Autonomie: Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie.

  • Maatschappelijke Impact: De kans om bij te dragen aan bekende, maatschappelijk relevante applicaties voor platformen zoals NPO Start, Pathé Thuis en het KNMI binnen een uitstekend beoordeeld top-tier maatwerk softwarebedrijf (Emerce100 koploper).

  • Salaris: Bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4000,- en €6000,- passend bij jouw ervaring.

  • Vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen om lekker uit te rusten.

  • Werkplek & Sfeer: Een fijne remote-first cultuur met volledige flexibiliteit, een gezellige werksfeer en inspirerende maandelijkse co-working dagen.

  • Mobiliteit & Thuiswerken: Kilometervergoeding van €0,25/km of volledige OV-vergoeding, gecombineerd met een maandelijkse thuiswerkvergoeding.

  • Pensioen: Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen.

  • Ontwikkeling & Extra's: Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen, plus actieve deelname en toegang tot het eigen event Appdevcon en diverse kennissessies.

  • De 'Gadget Kit': Een high-end MacBook Pro, een 27 inch 5K display, testdevices en een volledig ingerichte thuiswerkplek.

  • Events & Fun: Toffe teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events.

Over Dawn Technology

We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er écht toe doen – van zorg en educatie tot duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud en bouwen software die logisch voelt. En precies dát maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend.

Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis, zoeken we de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken we elkaar. Benieuwd om te horen hoe het is om bij Dawn Technology te werken? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast.

Solliciteren

Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Ook als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren. Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360.

Have a great day. Dawn Technology.

We gebruiken voor nieuwe kandidaten een assessment (actueel binnen software ontwikkeling) om het niveau objectief vast te stellen. Hiermee onderbouwen we de totstandkoming van het salaris in het recruitmentproces op basis van feitelijke vaardigheden. Dit geeft ons een eerlijk en meetbaar kader voor iedereen.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

title: Business Development Representative, Nordics
description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell:

Chainguard is building a safer foundation for software. We work with security and engineering teams who care deeply about supply chain security, open source, and modern infrastructure. We’re looking for a BDR who already knows how to run outbound, and is ready to take it further into more technical conversations, more complex organizations, and more strategic account development.

This role is about earning attention from engineers and security leaders, not just landing meetings. You’ll partner closely with enterprise AEs to break into high-value accounts and build pipeline that actually converts.

What you’ll do:

  • Drive enterprise account strategy - Work alongside AEs to map target accounts and identify the right entry points across security, platform, and engineering teams.
  • Run thoughtful, technical outbound - Craft highly personalized outreach that resonates with developers, DevOps, and security leaders — no generic sequences.
  • Understand how modern infrastructure works - Research how companies build and ship software (containers, CI/CD, cloud environments) to make your outreach relevant and credible.
  • Lead meaningful early conversations - Qualify opportunities by understanding technical context, risk posture, and business priorities.
  • Build real pipeline, not just meetings - Focus on creating opportunities that move forward — quality over quantity.
  • Act as an extension of the AE - Collaborate on account plans, messaging, and deal progression.
  • Use tools intelligently - Leverage Salesforce, Outreach/Salesloft, and data tools to execute efficiently — but never at the expense of quality.
  • Continuously improve the motion - Test messaging, share insights, and help refine how we engage the market.
  • Be a feedback loop to the business - Bring insights from conversations back to marketing and product — especially what resonates (or doesn’t) with technical buyers.

What we're looking for:

  • At least 6 months of BDR/SDR experience (or equivalent transferrable experience)
  • Proven ability to generate pipeline through outbound (not just inbound qualification)
  • Experience engaging multiple stakeholders within technical or complex organizations
  • Strong writing skills — especially in crafting personalized, relevant outreach
  • Curious and motivated to learn how modern software and security actually work
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and building your own approach
  • Experience with Salesforce, Outreach/Salesloft, or similar tools
  • Track record of hitting or exceeding pipeline targets
  • Candidates must have working fluency in 1 of these 3 languages: Danish, Swedish, or Norwegian.

What makes this role compelling:

  • Sell something technical buyers respect — security + open source + developer-first
  • Go deeper technically — engage with real infrastructure and security problems
  • Operate as part of the deal team — not just top-of-funnel support
  • Have real impact on revenue — not just activity metrics

About Us

We live and breathe our company values:

  • We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.
  • We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.
  • We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.
  • We trust each other and assume good intentions — We're transparent with decisions to empower team members to make well informed decisions.

A few of the benefits we offer:

  • Flexible & Remote-First Culture: Work remotely with team meetup opportunities, bi-annual destination summits, and a monthly stipend for coworking spaces, phone and internet costs.
  • Our Approach to Equity: Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).
  • 100% Covered Health Insurance: We cover 100% of your health, vision and dental insurance premiums for you and your dependents. Nothing comes out of your paycheck.
  • ∞ Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need – to do our best work, we need to recharge and reset.
  • 18 Weeks Paid Parental Leave: We offer 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents, with the option to use it all at once or throughout your child's first year.

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in technology and are focused on hiring "Chainguardians" with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

Chainguard is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Chainguard will process your personal data in accordance with Chainguard's Global Candidate Privacy Notice.

description:
At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health. Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!

We are looking for an experienced Group/IOP Therapist to join our virtual Intensive Outpatient Programs (vIOP)Â team. This role would be responsible for providing structured, group-based clinical care.Â We are looking for someone who has experience supporting individualized treatment planning, and collaborating with an interdisciplinary treatment team to promote client progress and continuity of care, and wants to bring their talents into a âfor purposeâ space. To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare.

*The schedule is Monday, Wednesday, and Thursdays from 5:00p-8:00p CST/EST. This is a part-time role that can expect to work between 10-12 hours per week (9 hours of direct programming and 2-3 hours of treatment planning, meetings and documentation).*

What Youâll Do

Clinical Service

    • Lead and co-facilitate structured, evidence-based virtual IOP group therapy sessions ensuring real-time clinical collaboration and balanced group management.
    • Adhere to a structured group block schedule, demonstrating punctuality and consistent attendance to maintain program continuity.
    • Assess client needs, establish treatment goals, and deliver clinically appropriate interventions for clients with higher-acuity behavioral health needs.
    • Monitor client progress, engagement, and clinical presentation; adjust treatment approaches as needed.
    • Identify and respond appropriately to changes in client risk or acuity, escalating concerns, executing appropriate crisis intervention protocols, and coordinating additional support when clinically indicated.
    • Maintain client engagement hours expectation on the platform.Â 
    • Complete clinical assessments, treatment plans, progress notes, and other required documentation accurately and on time.
    • Maintain compliance with applicable clinical standards, licensure requirements, and organizational policies.

Treatment Team Collaboration

    • Participate in regular interdisciplinary treatment team meetings to review client progress, coordinate care, and align on treatment plans.
    • Collaborate with other clinicians and care team members to support continuity of care, appropriate clinical interventions, and client transitions when needed.
    • Communicate relevant clinical updates and safety concerns to the appropriate members of the treatment team.
    • Complete and maintain necessary Treatment Team documentation notes weekly.Â 
    • Attend regular meetings with Team Lead.

Quality

    • Contribute to the consistent, high-quality delivery of virtual IOP services and adherence to program protocols.
    • Support a safe, therapeutic, and engaging virtual group environment.
    • Participate in clinical supervision, team meetings, and program-related activities as required.

Performs other related duties as assigned.Â 

About YouÂ 

  • Masterâs Degree in Social Work, Counseling, other Behavioral Science required.
  • 3-5 years experience in Behavioral Health.
  • Hold a current and valid independent license in either TX or FL to provide professional behavioral healthcare services.
  • Ability and willingness to work Mondays, Wednesdays and Thursdays between 5p-8p client's local time (CST or EST).
  • Experience with intensive outpatient programs (IOP), group-based treatment, or other structured levels of behavioral healthcare required.
  • Ability to deliver effective clinical care in a virtual setting and collaborate within an interdisciplinary treatment team.
  • Hold a current and valid independent license to provide professional behavioral healthcare services.

BenefitsÂ 

  • Six days of PTO annually, in addition to company holidays
  • Company-issued laptop
  • Reimbursement for applicable license renewal fees for licenses utilized in your work with Talkspace
  • Access to CEU Creations/CE4Less, providing continuing education opportunities to meet licensure requirements across all 50 statesÂ 

Compensation

At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.

The hourly rate for this role is $60.00/hr.

Why Talkspace?Â 

Talkspace is the worldâs leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the worldâs population â 2 billion people â live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.

Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind âgetting help,â we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. Dedicated to our mission, we are looking for candidates that want to bring their talents into a diverseÂ  âfor purposeâ space. title: Compliance Officer/MLRO
description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the worldâs leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 â connecting users to the future of digital finance.
Â 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
Â 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Role Purpose

Lead the establishment and ongoing oversight of the Pakistan entityâs independent Compliance function and Anti-Money Laundering, Counter-Terrorist Financing and Counter-Proliferation Financing (AML/CFT/CPF) framework.
During the pre-licensing phase, the role holder will lead Compliance-owned licensing deliverables, develop the local control framework and assess operational readiness. Following licensing, the role holder will discharge the entityâs CO/MLRO responsibilities, advise the Board and senior management, and maintain effective engagement with PVARA, the Financial Monitoring Unit (FMU) and other relevant authorities.
The role combines CO and MLRO responsibilities, subject to applicable regulatory requirements and any required regulatory acceptance or approval. The suitability of the combined arrangement will be reviewed periodically, considering independence, conflicts, capacity, resources and the entityâs nature, scale and complexity.
Â 

Key Responsibilities

  1. Licensing and Operational Readiness
  • Lead Compliance-owned components of the PVARA licensing application and coordinate relevant inputs from Legal, Business, Risk, Finance, Operations and Technology.
  • Develop and maintain a regulatory obligations register, licensing deliverables tracker and local implementation roadmap.
  • Assess gaps between group policies, systems and controls and applicable Pakistan requirements; oversee localisation and track remediation.
  • Establish local Compliance and AML/CFT/CPF policies, governance arrangements, escalation procedures and regulatory reporting processes.
  • Define local control requirements for customer onboarding, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, Travel Rule compliance and suspicious transaction reporting.
  • Assess the suitability and readiness of local, group-provided and outsourced controls, including relevant pre-launch testing.
  • Provide a documented Compliance and AML readiness assessment to the appropriate governance forum, escalating unresolved material gaps before launch.
Â 
  1. Compliance Oversight
  • Establish, administer and maintain a documented, risk-based Compliance Management System (CMS) proportionate to the entityâs activities and risk profile.
  • Advise the Board, relevant committees and senior management on applicable legal and regulatory requirements, licence conditions and regulatory developments.
  • Develop and execute a risk-based Compliance Monitoring and Testing Plan; document findings, agree remediation ownership and deadlines with accountable functions, independently validate closure, and escalate overdue or inadequate remediation.
  • Oversee compliance with applicable conduct, customer protection, complaints-handling, client-asset and market-integrity requirements, according to the entityâs licensed activities.
  • Review proposed products, services and material business changes from a local compliance perspective, identifying requirements, restrictions and necessary controls.
  • Ensure material non-compliance is investigated, promptly escalated and remediated, and notified to PVARA where required.
  • Maintain regulatory submission and commitment trackers, overseeing timely and accurate Compliance-owned responses and escalating dependency risks.
  • Act as the primary Compliance liaison with PVARA for supervisory engagement, inspections and information requests.
  • Develop and oversee Compliance training for employees, senior management and relevant key individuals.
Â 
  1. AML/CFT/CPF and Financial Crime
  • Establish, implement and maintain the entityâs AML/CFT/CPF framework, aligned with applicable Pakistan legislation, regulatory requirements and relevant directions or guidance.
  • Lead the enterprise-wide financial crime risk assessment and oversee risk-based mitigation measures.
  • Oversee customer due diligence, beneficial ownership identification, customer risk assessment, enhanced due diligence and ongoing monitoring.
  • Oversee transaction monitoring, sanctions screening and targeted financial sanctions controls, including escalation and action on relevant alerts.
  • Oversee virtual asset-specific controls, including blockchain analytics, risks associated with unhosted wallets and Travel Rule compliance where applicable.
  • Receive and assess internal suspicious activity referrals, determine whether external reporting is required, and submit suspicious transaction reports to the FMU within applicable deadlines.
  • Exercise independent judgement on suspicious transaction reporting without requiring business approval, while maintaining confidentiality and preventing tipping-off.
  • Manage the entityâs FMU/goAML registration, access arrangements and reporting processes, as applicable.
  • Ensure required customer, transaction and investigation records are retained for applicable periods and remain accessible and retrievable.
  • Liaise with the FMU and other competent authorities on financial crime matters and oversee relevant information requests.
  • Oversee AML/CFT/CPF training and awareness, tailored to employeesâ responsibilities and exposure to risk.
Â 
  1. Governance, Reporting and Control Assurance
  • Provide periodic reports to the Board or designated committee on Compliance and AML/CFT/CPF effectiveness, material risks, incidents, findings and remediation progress.
  • Escalate urgent or material matters promptly rather than waiting for scheduled reporting.
  • Attend relevant Board and committee meetings and provide independent advice and challenge.
  • Assess and oversee group-provided and outsourced Compliance/AML services, including local regulatory suitability, service standards, data access, management information and escalation arrangements.
  • Oversee delegated Compliance and AML/CFT/CPF activities and remain accountable for discharging the CO/MLRO responsibilities, without displacing the responsibilities of the entity, Board, senior management or operational control owners.
  • Coordinate with Risk and Internal Audit, while preserving the distinction between Compliance oversight and independent audit assurance.
  • Support periodic review of the role holderâs continuing fitness, propriety and suitability, including the required review of the MLRO appointment.
  • Maintain effective handover and suitably qualified cover arrangements for absences, consistent with applicable regulatory requirements.
Â 

Qualifications and Experience

Essential
  • A degree in law, finance, business or a related discipline, or an equivalent relevant professional qualification.
  • At least eight yearsâ relevant Compliance and/or AML/CFT experience in financial services, including at least three years in a senior Compliance, MLRO or equivalent leadership role.
  • Strong knowledge of Pakistanâs financial regulatory and AML/CFT framework, including the Virtual Assets Act, applicable PVARA regulations, the Anti-Money Laundering Act and FMU reporting requirements.
  • Demonstrable understanding of virtual asset business models and their financial crime, conduct and operational risks.
  • Practical experience with customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, investigations and suspicious transaction reporting.
  • Experience developing risk assessments, policies, monitoring programmes and Board-level reporting.
  • Ability to translate regulatory requirements into workable business, operational and technology controls.
  • Be resident in Pakistan by the date of the formal CO/MLRO appointment and maintain residency as required under applicable regulations.
  • Fluency in English and Urdu.
Â 
Desirable
  • Professional certification such as CAMS, an ICA qualification or an equivalent Compliance/AML credential.
  • Experience in virtual assets, exchanges, fintech or digital financial services.
  • Experience supporting a regulatory licence application or establishing a local Compliance function.
  • Experience engaging with PVARA, FMU, SECP, SBP or other relevant Pakistani authorities.
  • Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools and Travel Rule solutions.
  • Experience overseeing centralised group services and outsourced control arrangements.
Â 
Key Competencies
  • Independence, integrity and sound judgement.
  • Confidence to challenge senior management constructively.
  • Clear communication with regulators, the Board and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong analytical, investigative and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective prioritisation in a developing regulatory environment.
  • Ability to build a local control framework while working within a global organisation.
Â 
Authority and Independence
  • Direct access to the local Board or designated committee, including the ability to escalate without prior management clearance.
  • Timely and unrestricted access to relevant records, systems, personnel and management information necessary to discharge the role, subject to applicable confidentiality and data-handling requirements.
  • Adequate resources and suitably qualified support proportionate to the entityâs activities and risk profile.
  • No client-facing, sales or other responsibilities that compromise independence, create material conflicts or impair CO/MLRO duties.
  • Remuneration arrangements that do not link the role holderâs performance to sales or revenue targets.
  • Group reporting arrangements that do not restrict local regulatory accountability, Board access or independent MLRO decision-making.
  • Board oversight of appointment, replacement and removal, with regulatory approvals or notifications completed as applicable.
Â 
Regulatory Appointment Conditions
The role holder must satisfy applicable fitness and propriety, residency, employment, competence and regulatory appointment requirements at appointment and on an ongoing basis. Any required PVARA approval, acceptance or notification must be completed in accordance with the applicable framework.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.Â 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.

- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

You’ll then also have the opportunity to test and scale new channels (TikTok, Meta, Snapchat, Native, ASA) depending on performance and market constraints.

Campaign Ownership and Scaling

Automation & Scaling Systems

  • Contribute to growing the user base from 30M to 100M users in the next 12 months

  • Execute 0-to-1 testing in new channels

  • Improve conversion through landing page testing and funnel iteration

  • Own both creative input and analytical feedback loops

Hard Skills

  • Proven track record managing $300K to $1M+/month in paid media spend

  • Full ownership of campaign execution, results, and optimization

  • Experience with Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, ASA, or native platforms

  • Analytical fluency: GA4, Voluum, tracking setups, dashboards

  • Strong creative instincts: can write briefs, analyze hooks, and iterate fast

title: Account Executive
description:
Zone & Company Software Consulting LLC (“Zone”) is the ERP-native AI platform for financial operations, purpose-built for organizations running on Oracle NetSuite. We are redefining how finance teams operate by delivering an AI-powered system that automates, connects, and scales financial workflows directly within the ERP.

As the AI operating system for finance teams in NetSuite, Zone enables more than 4,500 customers worldwide to run smarter, faster, and with greater accuracy. Our platform spans the full financial lifecycle, including Quote-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Treasury, Payroll Management, and Record-to-Report, eliminating manual processes and unlocking real-time financial intelligence.

By embedding intelligence directly into NetSuite, Zone helps finance teams move beyond reactive work to proactive, strategic impact. Learn more at www.zoneandco.com or follow us on LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/zoneandco.

About the role

Zone & Co. is looking for a high-velocity Account Executive to sell finance automation solutions to the Office of the CFO. We move fast, set ambitious goals, and expect our team to deliver. Our targets are designed to be achievable, and we're looking for disciplined, driven sellers who know how to manage a pipeline, maintain deal momentum, and consistently convert opportunities into closed business.

You'll own pipeline generation through strategic outbound prospecting, complemented by additional opportunities from our partner ecosystem and marketing team.

If you thrive in a fast-paced sales environment, are comfortable navigating short sales cycles, bring rigor to your MEDDPICC process, and enjoy building relationships face-to-face with partners and customers, this could be the opportunity for you. You'll also have the chance to develop deep expertise across a broad and growing product portfolio in a dynamic, expanding market.

What you'll do:

  • Own a net new number. Win new logos across a defined EMEA territory against an annual ARR target, measured monthly and quarterly.
  • Build your own pipeline. Outbound is part of the job, every week: calls, sequences, LinkedIn, and your own network. Partner and marketing leads are a bonus, not the plan.
  • Get out there. Travel to partner offices, industry events, and customer meetings. Face time with partners and clients is key.
  • Work the partner ecosystem. Build trusted relationships with our implementation and referral partners so they bring you in early and back you to close.
  • Run a high-velocity motion. Manage 30 + active opportunities at once and close 10–15 deals a month, from first call through pricing, paper process and signature.
  • Sell with discipline. Use MEDDPICC on every deal: find the pain, the metrics and the economic buyer, build a champion, and run a clear close plan with a next step every time.
  • Sell the whole journey. We are positioning the complete end-to-end story. We want to connect the customer pain with how to solve finance challenges, and turn that vision into bigger, multi-product wins.
  • Partner with Solution Consulting. Bring in SCs at the right moment for sharp, tailored demos on larger deals.
  • Forecast accurately. Keep Salesforce clean and call your number with confidence every week.

What success looks like:

  • You consistently hit, and regularly beat, your monthly and quarterly ARR targets.
  • Your pipeline is a good mix of self-sourced and partner-sourced from relationships you've built.
  • Partners know you by name and bring you into their deals early.
  • Your deals are MEDDPICC-complete, your forecast is reliable, and your average deal size grows as you sell more of the platform.

What you'll bring:

  • 5+ years closing net new SaaS business, with a track record of hitting and overachieving ARR targets in a fast-paced, transactional or mid-market motion.
  • A real outbound habit: you prospect daily and you're proud of the pipeline you create yourself.
  • Strong MEDDPICC (or MEDDIC) skills, applied for real, not just known.
  • Commercial acumen: you understand ROI, pricing and negotiation, and you're comfortable talking value with finance leaders and CFOs.
  • Experience selling to the Office of the CFO AP Automation, Procure-to-Pay, billing, payments or order-to-cash, is a big plus. NetSuite ecosystem experience is a bonus.
  • A diligent, organised approach: you manage a busy pipeline without dropping the detail.
  • A keen eye to learn. Our product set grows through innovation and acquisition, and you'll want to master new products fast.
  • Happy on the road: comfortable travelling to partner sites, events and client meetings across the UK and EMEA.
  • Confident with Salesforce, Gong and modern sales tools. As well as AI tools such as Clay and Claude.

Benefits

At Zone, we provide the platform; you provide the grit. We operate as a high-velocity, fully remote, global team where autonomy isn't just a perk, it’s the standard. We’re looking for self-driven professionals eager to navigate the complexities of a unique SaaS environment and take full command of their professional evolution.

We ditch micro-management for high-trust flexibility, ensuring you have the space to innovate and scale. Our benefits are built to fuel this lifestyle, supporting your life beyond the screen so you can focus on making a global impact. Explore our offerings at https://www.zoneandco.com/careers

Join Our Global Mission

Zone & Co is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. We thrive on unique perspectives and strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Here, your identity is valued, and your talent is the only limit to your growth. All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, religion, sex, orientation, age, disability, or any other protected factor.

Employment Terms

United States

Employment with Zone is “At-Will”, meaning either party may terminate the relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law. This job description does not constitute an employment contract or guarantee of continued employment. Duties and responsibilities may evolve as the company grows and may change at any time with or without notice.

Non-US Jurisdictions

This position is offered as a Fixed-Term or Permanent Contract based on your country of residence. Employment is subject to a written contract which outlines specific notice periods, probationary terms, and statutory entitlements.

Privacy Statement and Applicant Privacy Notice.

title: Risk Operations Specialist, AMER
description:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.

About the Role: Binance Risk Operation team is seeking an experienced Risk Operations Specialist to implement effective risk control for the Binance platform and its users. You will be responsible for reviewing a range of predetermined alerts, as well as service requests, to determine whether recent account activity may be fraudulent in nature.

You will carry out investigations using multiple resources, including customer contact, reviewing account activity, assessing phone number matching, IP searches, and various online tools. Risk Operations Specialists are customer-focused and aim to enhance customers’ understanding of our account processes. At the same time, you will educate customers on maintaining account security and work to prevent losses for both the company and its users.

You will be responsible for reviewing documentation, analysing data, and making timely decisions on whether to verify the authenticity of transactions and/or activities. Throughout this process, you may need to communicate with customers to request additional information or to notify them of outcomes. A Risk Operations Specialist is organised, efficient, and motivated, demonstrates strong analytical skills, adapts well to change, and thrives in a collaborative team environment.

This position will operate in alignment with US time zone and requires shift-based operation, including potential weekends and public holidays.

What You’ll Do:

  • Review and investigate risk-related cases, including KYC verification, account takeover concerns, two-factor authentication resets, withdrawal reviews, and abnormal trading activities (60%).
  • Monitor account activity to detect unusual or suspicious behaviour and take appropriate action to prevent fraudulent or unauthorized transactions (15%).
  • Contact account holders to verify account activity, investigate concerns, and mitigate potential losses (10%).
  • Assess suspicious activities, identify potential risk indicators, and make timely, well-reasoned decisions in accordance with established procedures (10%).
  • Maintain accurate and comprehensive case documentation to support auditability and quality assurance (5%)

What We’re Looking For:

  • Minimum of 3–5 years of proven experience in high-risk, rule-based, or process-driven environments, preferably within financial services, fraud prevention, risk management, or compliance.
  • Work independently with minimal supervision, taking full ownership of assigned cases and responsibility
  • Flexible and willing to support weekend coverage as part of a team operating on a 7-day schedule.
  • Hands-on experience conducting KYC (Know Your Customer), KYB (Know Your Business), account take over and transaction-related investigations.
  • Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to identify patterns, anomalies, and potential risks within transaction data.
  • Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear, concise, and well-supported case documentation and recommendations.
  • Proven ability to make sound judgment calls and risk-based decisions in ambiguous situations while working with minimal supervision.
  • Demonstrated ability to maintain a high level of accuracy, consistency, and attention to detail while performing effectively under pressure and managing competing priorities.

Why Binance

  • Shape the future of finance
  • Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
  • Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy
  • Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
  • Competitive salary and company benefits
  • Remote-first, work-from-home arrangement (may vary depending on the nature of the role and team)

Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

By submitting a job application, you acknowledge that you have read our Candidate Privacy Notice.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Collections Analyst I
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

We are looking for a self-starting, motivated, and experienced Collections Specialist to support the small business globally. The Collection Analyst oversees the accounts receivable efforts of a global portfolio of monthly receivables and acts as the conduit between the sales team, the customer, and corporate. This opportunity requires a candidate with a high volume accounts-centric mindset, high attention to detail, excellent problem-solving abilities, and an enthusiastic attitude. Candidates must have the ability to juggle multiple tasks and priorities, thrive in a highly driven environment, enjoy learning new skills, procedures, and systems, and have an overall desire to contribute to company growth. This position plays an essential role in minimizing our financial loss by implementing receivable and collection procedures that reduce the amount of delinquency encountered and reports to our Sr. Manager, Order to Cash.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Mexico.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, and countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Manage a portfolio of global customers
  • Be responsible for updating management on customer payment issues
  • Act as primary AR contact for the sales team
  • Perform consistent collections diligence to ensure timely conversion of past due and current accounts receivable
  • Escalate past due accounts for review and approval for account suspension or when account resolution has not occurred within certain timelines
  • Resolve customer issues preventing payment timely and accurately within prescribed SLA commitments
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to resolve account issues such as pricing, returns, or defective items
  • Reconcile customer accounts to resolve discrepancies caused by misapplied payments or other account issues as needed
  • Maintain account data as needed for accurate customer information
  • Coordinate support and/or resolution for the Account Team (AE or CSM) with questions about billing and contracts or escalate to the Invoice Team when necessary
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s Operating Principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in finance.
  • 2+ years of business-to-business collections experience
  • Fluency in English and Spanish
  • Knowledge of operational accounts receivable processes
  • Excellent customer service skills to provide best-in-class service
  • Must be able to meet or exceed deadlines with a strong attention to detail
  • Strong ability to prioritize and organize work effectively
  • Strong, effective communication skills
  • Must be able to collaborate and communicate effectively
  • Experience with NetSuite, SFDC, and intermediate Excel skills is strongly preferred6
  • Highly organized, self-disciplined, and ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Critical thinker, able to implement scalable processes
  • Strong organization skills with exceptional attention to detail and follow-through
  • Experience with SaaS and or technology firms with high volume and growth

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Influencer Executive
description:
Reports to: Influencer and Advocacy Manager

Location: Remote, UK

Salary: £32,000 - £35,000

About TrustedHousesitters

At TrustedHousesitters, we connect a global community of pet lovers through a shared love of travel, pets, and authentic connection. For over a decade, our members have unlocked a world of house sitting, pet sitting, and authentic travel experiences.

We know that our community’s real-life stories are our most powerful marketing asset. We are seeking an energetic, relationship-focused Influencer Executive to build and nurture a thriving ecosystem of creators, house sitters, pet owners, and brand advocates. In this role, you will champion the everyday members who genuinely love our platform, bringing authentic stories of pet care and unique stays to the forefront of our brand strategy.

Role Overview

As the Influencer Executive, you will facilitate the end-to-end management of our user-generated content (UGC) ecosystem and creator programs. You will be responsible for sourcing authentic pet-and-travel content, nurturing organic sitters and owners into long-term brand advocates, and building the foundations of a community strategy that puts our members first.

You will report directly to the Head of Brand & Content while working closely with the Paid Media Team and Brand to ensure member stories flow seamlessly into our marketing campaigns and digital platforms.

Key Responsibilities

Creator community

  • Identify and develop a pool of genuine brand advocates from within our existing customer base (pet owners and sitters), building long-term, high-trust relationships.
  • Maintain a tiered framework spanning organic advocates, micro-creators, and paid creators to ensure an active, rolling talent pipeline.
  • Support the Influencer and Advocacy Manager to launch engagement initiatives, creator programs, and local sitter/owner events that bring our global community together.
  • Monitor community performance metrics, content trends, and audience narratives to inform cross-functional alignment.

Production management

  • Proactively search, vet, recruit, and brief creators for specific campaign requirements across organic channels, paid ad funnels, and platform listing imagery.
  • Manage high-volume outreach without losing the warm, personal touch that reflects our pet-loving community.
  • Create compelling creative briefs for creators, balancing brand guidelines with authentic, relatable member storytelling (e.g., house tours, pet care routines, travel diaries).
  • Monitor, curate, and request usage permissions for high-quality imagery directly from member listings (homes and pets), ensuring these authentic assets are collected and shared with marketing and product teams for multi-channel use.

Operations and logistics

  • Assist the Influencer and Advocacy Manager with creator contracts, usage rights, licensing terms, and repost permissions.
  • Oversee the digital asset management system for storing, organising, and distributing creator assets so they are easily accessible to paid media, product, email marketing, and web teams.
  • Triage inbound creator inquiries, and oversee product/perk distribution for creator campaigns.

Integrations and feedback

  • Work with the Head of Brand to ensure UGC is integrated strategically across the content calendar, email, and landing pages.
  • Work directly with the paid marketing team to test, iterate, and boost high-performing UGC assets across digital channels.
  • Track, interpret and learn from performance metrics (engagement, reach, CTR, conversion rate, asset quality) to continuously refine creator selection and briefs, and deliver regular reporting on creator impact.
  • Support on cross-brand partnerships and co-marketing executions, when applicable.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proficiency in UGC management, influencer marketing, creator outreach, or social media management within a consumer-facing brand.
  • Highly organised with experience managing multiple content creators, contracts, and asset libraries simultaneously without dropping details.
  • A sharp taste level with an intuitive sense of what looks and feels authentic, high-quality, and on-brand for TrustedHousesitters.
  • Solid understanding of digital asset licensing, creator usage rights, and copyright management across social/paid channels.
  • You want to understand how and why things work (or why they don’t). You proactively seek out ways to improve performance, challenge assumptions and strive to take things to the next level.
  • You’re always seeking to develop your skill set, both within your role and in adjacent areas. You stay up-to-date with recent trends, seeking to operate at the forefront of your field consistently as it evolves.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and written communication skills - you know how to turn casual users into passionate, long-term brand advocates.
  • You’re comfortable working in a high-growth, fast-moving environment that is constantly evolving.
  • A genuine love for animals, travel, and building genuine human connections. You naturally think beyond follower counts to build true community.

Nice to Haves

  • Hands-on experience with creator platforms (e.g., Duel, Dash Social or other creator management platforms) and social analytics tools.
  • Experience working in a variety of business environments, particularly within fast paced start/scale-ups, marketing agencies, marketplaces, travel or pets.
  • Experience with content creation, video editing or basic graphic design tools (e.g., CapCut, Premiere, Canva) to quickly repurpose UGC assets for short-form video (TikTok, Reels, Shorts).
  • Comfortable being on camera.

We offer a range of benefits, including:

🐾 For the love of pets

  • Each year, you’ll get a Premium TrustedHousesitters Combined membership which includes benefits like free airport lounge passes, Sit Cancellation Plan and Home and Contents Plan, plus five Premium memberships to gift to friends and family
  • Our team can work remotely from as many house sits as they like, and we contribute up to £500 per
    year towards travel costs to and from sits
  • Find a rescue pet to join your family and we’ll cover the adoption fees, as well as “pawternity” to help your pet settle into their new home

💜 Health & wellbeing

  • SimplyHealth healthcare cash plan
  • Bupa Health Insurance and Dental Insurance plan
  • Specsavers eyecare scheme
  • Weekly virtual yoga sessions
  • Optional enrollment onto our Trusted Giving scheme, which includes employee giving via Charities Trust and 2 days paid annual volunteering allowance

💻 Working environment

  • Work fully remotely from anywhere in the world - as long as you follow compliance as a UK tax resident
  • Get £200 to spend on home office equipment each year + Macbook and Apple accessories when you start
  • Access to Spaces co-working locations across the globe
  • We host an all-expenses-paid meetup each quarter and fund team events (remote or in-person) throughout the year
  • We cover the costs of personal development resources and have regular time set aside for learning and growth
  • Depending on your role within the business, you’ll have the option to customise your work hours to better align with your personal schedule

💰 Compensation & time off

  • 25 days off per year, plus bank holidays and festive closure between Christmas and New Year (36 days + Christmas Day for some roles)
  • Competitive salary which is reviewed annually
  • Generous equity package for permanent employees
  • Discretionary 10% quarterly bonus scheme, distributed quarterly
  • Pension scheme: 5% from you as an employee and 3% from TrustedHousesitters
  • £500 recruitment referral bonus

If you're ready to join us on our mission to become the most loved pet travel solution, we'd love to hear from you!

In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example- she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

At the heart of our team are a mix of diverse backgrounds. Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re committed to the equal opportunities policy throughout the interview process and selection. Offers of employment into TrustedHousesitters are based solely on individual merit, qualifications, and the person's professional suitability.

Gender identity, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, colour, race, nationality, ethnic or national origins, religion or beliefs, age, mental or physical disability, medical condition, pregnancy or maternity status, or any other protected characteristics do not enter into our decision-making process.

title: Consultant Neurologist PAYE
description:
Our patients have often tried everything. Years of appointments, medications that did not work, conditions that slowly took over their lives. By the time they reach us, many have run out of road with conventional treatment. You could be the clinician that changes that.

We are Montu UK, one of the UK's largest medical cannabis clinics, and we are looking for Consultant Neurologists to join our clinical team.

About the role

You will assess and manage patients exploring cannabis based medicines, making the clinical call on whether treatment is appropriate and managing their care from there. This is still a young field. The evidence base is growing, best practice is being written in real time, and you will have a genuine hand in shaping it.

You do not need experience with cannabis based medicines. You need sound clinical judgement, an open mind and an interest in doing things differently. We provide full specialist training, and our multidisciplinary model means you are never working in isolation. Nurses and pharmacists handle pre consultation and follow up tasks, so your time is spent where it matters: with patients.

What you will be doing:

  • Providing high quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment

  • Conducting patient consultations, including assessment and ongoing management

  • Contributing to clinical outcome data collection to support evidence based practice

  • Supporting clinical governance and maintaining robust standards of patient care

  • Working closely within a multidisciplinary team of nurses and pharmacists

  • Taking part in ongoing training and development, including bespoke specialist training in cannabis based medicines (CBPMs)

What you need:

  • Full GMC Registration

  • Completion of Specialist Training (CCST/CCT) or equivalent certification

  • On the GMC Specialist Register for Neurology

  • A genuine interest in alternative therapies

  • Willingness to participate in data collection and reporting

Why join us?

  • Highly competitive salary

  • Flexible working with full time or part time options

  • Comprehensive indemnity coverage. Montu covers all professional and clinical indemnity insurance for your work with us

  • Private healthcare scheme

  • No night shifts and no on call

  • CPD accredited medical cannabis education and specialist in house training from industry leaders

  • A collaborative multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals

  • The chance to be part of a pioneering field and shape the future of medical cannabis care in the UK

Training and development:

  • Attendance at a recognised Medical Cannabis Course for Specialist Physicians, sponsored by Montu

  • Specialist training delivered by experts

  • Ongoing support on clinical protocols, prescribing practices and Montu's systems

Working arrangements:

  • Fully remote with flexible working hours and days

  • Standard sessions are 4 hours of patient consultations, and you choose your preferred days and hours

  • To support onboarding, we ask for a minimum commitment of 2 sessions per week (8 hours) initially, so you become confident with our platform

  • Appointments are 15 minutes for new and existing patients. Our multidisciplinary model means nurses and pharmacists handle pre consultation and follow up prescribing tasks, so Consultants focus on prescribing and patient care

About Montu

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis based medicines. We exist to transform lives by improving access to safe, effective treatment and delivering an exceptional standard of care. We move quickly, we care deeply about our patients, and we are building something that did not exist in UK healthcare five years ago.

If that sounds like your kind of place, we would love to hear from you.

title: Care Coordinator
description:
Company Overview

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

Be part of a team that makes a real difference.

Job Description

You must be available from 8 AM - 8 PM EST as your Shift will be Assigned by the Management Team

  • Serves as the primary point of contact for individuals with complex and catastrophic injuries.
  • Evaluate referrals and determine case eligibility, complexity, and immediate needs.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary services and facilitate transitions between providers and care settings, when applicable.
  • Serves as a central liaison among clients, adjusters, nurse case managers, providers, vendors, caregivers, and internal stakeholders to drive optimal patient outcomes and client satisfaction.
  • Lead roundtable discussions for complex cases, provide updates on treatment progress, identify barriers to care, coordinate action plans, and drive accountability for follow-up activities.
  • Manage vendor and service coordination, including DME, home health, transportation, home modifications, nursing care, and other specialty solutions.
  • Build strong relationships with clients, adjusters, nurse case managers, providers and vendors and establish communication protocols and stakeholder expectations.
  • Provide ongoing communication, case updates, documentation, and advocacy to support optimal outcomes and continuity of care.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required. Bachelor's degree in a related field is preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of experience in healthcare coordination, workers' compensation (a plus), care coordination, customer service, or a related healthcare environment.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple complex cases simultaneously.
  • Demonstrated critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  • Experience working independently while collaborating effectively across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Ability to lead collaborative meetings, build consensus among stakeholders, resolve barriers, and ensure commitments and deliverables are completed on schedule.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively engage with clients, providers, nurse case managers and other key stakeholders.

Benefits

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full-time or part-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $23.14 - $25.00 hourly, and will be based on a number of additional factors including skills, experience, and education.

The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and underrepresented minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
description:
Job Title: Patient Care Advocate 

Job Location: Remote


About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview: 

As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. 


What You’ll Do: 

  • Patient Enrollment & Eligibility: Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. 
  • Prescription Coverage: Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. 
  • Cost-Sharing & Payment: Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. 
  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. 
  • Refills & Continued Use: Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. 
  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. 


What We’re Looking For: 

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes
  • Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies
  • A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access
  • The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment

Success Factors for Working from Home 

  • Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. 
  • Ergonomics: A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment. 
  • Reliable Internet Connection: Stable, high-speed internet with a minimum bandwidth of 10 Mbps downstream and 5 Mbps upstream. 
  • Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace: A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. 
  • Tech-Savvy: Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. 
  • Self-motivation & Independence: Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. 
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. 
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. 


Compensation & Perks 

  • Hourly Pay: $16.50 per hour 
  • Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. 
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. 
  • Cell Phone Benefits: $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). 
  • Generous Referral Program: Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. 
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. 
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. 
  • Work-from-Home Convenience: Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. 
  • Inclusive Culture: We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. 

What Success Looks Like: 

  • Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance 
  • Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals 
  • High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience 
  • Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance 

Why Join Us? 

  • Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications 
  • Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors 
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package 
  • A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture 

Ready to Make an Impact? 

Join us in making prescription medications more affordable and accessible for those who need them most. If you're ready to help make a difference, we'd love to hear from you! 

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

title: Content Reviewer - United States
description:
Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust.

 

In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.

 

  • Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment
  • Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories
  • Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance
  • Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness
  • Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models

 

Qualifications to succeed in this project:

 

  • Professional fluency in English
  • Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years  
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture
  • Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities
  • Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher)
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred)

 

Why join the project:

 

  • Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling
  • Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains
  • Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment
  • Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly trustworthy, this work is built for that mindset.
  • Responsive support: Direct access to evaluation support staff for clarification on ambiguous queries or technical guidance
 
Qualification path

How to get started:

  • Complete your contributor profile and application
  • Take a qualification assessment at your own pace within the time given
  • Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process
  • Acceptance form & Rater Academy: Complete an acceptance form and approximately 2.5 hours of Rater Academy training
  • Receive your project assignment and access credentials

 

Service Rates 

The rate of pay is 0.2333 USD per task, with an estimated earning potential of 14 USD per hour.

Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

 

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.
