title: Technical Architect
description:
Role Description

As a Technical Architect at Dropbox, you will help enterprise customers translate business goals and complex technical requirements into practical solution architectures. You will work with customers and internal teams to design how Dropbox fits into their existing systems, validate critical assumptions, and guide implementation and adoption.

You will lead architecture discussions spanning workflows, integrations, identity and access, data movement, and operational readiness. You will explain design choices and tradeoffs, identify technical risks early, and produce clear guidance that implementation teams can act on. You will also turn lessons from customer engagements into reusable patterns and actionable feedback for Product and Engineering.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical discovery with customer business and IT stakeholders to establish requirements, constraints, dependencies, and measurable success criteria.
  • Design and document solution architectures, including system boundaries, integration and data flows, identity and permission models, and operational requirements.
  • Evaluate design options and explain tradeoffs in reliability, security, performance, implementation effort, and ongoing cost.
  • Validate high-risk assumptions through focused prototypes, integration tests, or technical evaluations with explicit acceptance criteria.
  • Guide implementation and migration planning, defining sequencing, owners, testing, cutover, rollback, and handoff to delivery and support teams.
  • Partner with Customer Success, Support, Sales, Product, and Engineering to resolve technical blockers and connect architecture decisions to customer outcomes.
  • Create reusable reference architectures, implementation guidance, and enablement materials; mentor colleagues and communicate recurring product gaps.

Requirements

  • Customer-facing technical experience: At least 3 years in technical architecture, solutions architecture, implementation consulting, or a similar role, leading discovery, solution design, demonstrations, and technical validation for enterprise SaaS customers.
  • AI experience: Experience using AI tools for technical analysis, solution design, or prototyping, including validating outputs, protecting customer data, and assessing limitations.
  • Integration expertise: Experience designing and troubleshooting API integrations, authentication, data flows, and failure handling.
  • Identity and access: Understanding of IAM and Zero Trust principles, including SSO, SAML, OAuth/OIDC, SCIM, MFA, RBAC, conditional access, and how permissions and sharing affect data exposure.
  • Implementation and migration: Experience planning implementations or migrations and coordinating dependencies, technical risks, and handoffs across teams.
  • Technical communication: Ability to write clear technical documentation, lead workshops, and explain design decisions to technical and business audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Expertise in at least one of the following areas:

  • CASB/SSE/DLP platforms: Experience with enterprise security platforms such as Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, Forcepoint, Broadcom/Symantec DLP, or similar technologies.

  • Identity and access management: Experience with platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, or Ping Identity, including managing identities, permissions, and groups and applying least-privilege access principles to SaaS applications.

  • Security ecosystems and integrations: Experience with SIEM/SOAR platforms, APIs, OAuth, event and audit logs, or security integrations, including an understanding of how SaaS and data security solutions fit into a customerâs broader security architecture.

  • Security and compliance frameworks: Experience applying frameworks or regulatory requirements such as NIST CSF, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS to address enterprise customer needs.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read thisÂ blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

title: 3D Environment Artist & Level Designer
description:
3D Environment Artist & Level Designer
ScapeWorld Entertainment · Remote

  • Level: Senior to lead

  • Location: Remote, CET overlap

  • Contract: Full time, long term

About us

We are ScapeWorld Entertainment, a fully remote Swedish game studio of just over 20 people. We are building Scape, a platform of multiplayer games where a player’s identity carries across all of them. We have just launched our first game within Scape. Our senior team has shipped and run live games at studios including Arrowhead (Helldivers 2), Avalanche Studios and Ubisoft.

The project

Our next game is a cleaning and restoration sim set in a shared neighbourhood. Every player has a place of their own that starts buried in junk and grime, and puts it in order in full view of neighbours who are doing the same.

Cleaning games are usually played alone or in short co-op sessions. We want to make one set in a neighbourhood that players share and keep coming back to, and we want to do it well. We have a working prototype and are refining the loop now. If you play games like this and have views on what makes them satisfying, you will enjoy this.

About the role

We are looking for a senior to lead 3D environment artist who is also a level designer.

You will be the only level designer on the project. You own the game’s spaces, from first layout through to dressed and lit, and you are responsible for delivering them.

The role is split roughly evenly between environment art, mostly props and other environment 3D assets, and level design, which includes some gameplay design. On the design side you work with our Creative Director and engineering, and you bring your level and gameplay design experience into those discussions. On the art side you work with the rest of the art team.

You report to the Art Director.

What you will do

Environment art

  • Model and texture props and other environment 3D assets. Most of what we use is made in-house, and we also work with asset packs where they fit.

  • Work to our polygon, texture and material standards. Assets used in large numbers, such as foliage, are kept low poly. Most props use standard poly counts.

  • Build modular kits that can be reused across levels.

  • Dress and light levels in Unity, following the Art Director’s visual direction.

Level design

  • Design the layout of rooms and plots: how the player moves through them, what they notice first, and the order in which the space is revealed as it is cleared.

  • Greybox levels and take them through to final, checking scale, pathing and collision in engine.

  • Test levels in engine and in playtests, and make changes based on the results.

  • Help shape how spaces support the game loop and its features, and give input on pacing and progression.

  • Document your work: layout plans, kit guides and dressing guidelines.

What we are looking for

  • Senior to lead level, with several years of professional experience in game development.

  • Experience as both an environment artist and a level designer. You have done each on at least one project, shipped or not, and you have owned a game’s spaces or levels from start to finish.

  • Some gameplay design experience, for example working on game loops, features or mechanics alongside level layouts.

  • A portfolio that shows both sides: real-time environments and 3D assets you made, and levels you designed, from greybox to final.

  • Good working knowledge of Unity, including building and lighting levels. Our level tools are built inside Unity.

  • Comfortable using Blender. It is part of our production pipeline, and we have built an add-on for it.

  • Comfortable using the Substance suite for texturing and materials.

  • Comfortable giving your view in design discussions and explaining your reasoning.

  • Able to work independently from a brief, and to work closely with a small team.

  • Comfortable working in English every day, in meetings (mostly on camera) and in writing. It does not need to be perfect.

Nice to have

  • 3D character or gameplay animation.

  • 3D character modelling.

  • Technical art or VFX.

  • Experience with GitHub or Fork.

  • Experience with player-built levels, or tools for game creators.

  • Experience in a small team where you covered more than one role.

What we offer

  • A fully remote team with flexible working.

  • Trust to manage your own time. We do not use timesheets.

  • Ownership of the game’s spaces, from first layout to final.

  • A small team where people help each other.

Working setup

  • Fully remote. Your working day needs to overlap with CET.

  • Full time, on a long-term contract. It is business to business.

  • We would like you to start as soon as you are available.

What this role is not

  • Not a lead game designer role. Our Creative Director sets the direction of the game.

  • Not an art-only or design-only role. You will do both.

How to apply

Apply through the link; a few short questions are part of the application form. If we shortlist you, the next step is interviews, and for final candidates an unpaid planning task of about two hours at an agreed time, with no modelling or texturing. We reply to everyone at every step.

Disclosure

This application will be evaluated with the help of an AI tool that checks your CV and application against the criteria for this role. A human recruiter always makes the final decision. The AI does not reject or accept anyone on its own. If your application isn’t taken forward, you can ask us for an explanation of how the AI was used in that decision. See our Candidate Privacy Policy below for full details, or contact us at

  • Experience with instrumentation, sensors, data acquisition, electrical wiring, vacuum, cryogenics or superconducting hardware.

Explore your future career  🔭

As our new Client Operations Specialist (Invoice to Cash), you will join the Client Ops team within the Finance department, reporting to Patricia Legendre. 

Based in our Paris office, you will take ownership of the Invoice-to-Cash cycle for our Public Sector and complex accounts in France.

Unlike standard automated billing, public sector contracts come with specific administrative requirements. You will play a key role in ensuring billing accuracy, securing cash collection, and supporting our growth across this portfolio.




Key responsibilities ✨

  • Manage manual invoicing: Track purchase order consumption, validate deliverable receipt, and process invoice splits for public sector clients.

  • Drive cash collection: Monitor overdue payments and clear administrative blockers directly with clients to secure payments.

  • Execute manual cash allocation: Allocate incoming payments daily and resolve reconciliation discrepancies.

  • Identify and resolve anomalies: Spot billing or payment errors and review historical records to fix blockers at their source.

  • Manage JIRA tickets and stakeholder requests: Partner daily with COS (Customer Onboarding and Success), Sales, and freelancers to track client specifics.

  • Update reporting and processes: Maintain collection tracking and streamline billing setups for new public tenders.


    • About you 🧑‍🚀

  • Experience: You have proven experience in operational finance (billing, cash collection, accounts receivable, or banking back-office), ideally involving public sector contracts or complex B2B accounts.

  • Investigative & Tenacious Mindset: When facing a blocker, you dig into historical records to solve the issue at its source and thrive during peak activity at the beginning and end of each month.

  • Rigor & Organization: With each public sector client having its own rules, you are methodical, autonomous, and highly detail-oriented.

  • Technical Skills: You have strong Excel skills and feel comfortable with financial tools (experience with JIRA or cash collection tools is a plus).

  • Communication: You bring strong interpersonal skills to engage with public administrations and collaborate daily with internal teams (COS, Sales).

  • Languages: You have a bilingual level in French and a good working level in English.


    • How to join the mission? 🚀

  • Initial Screening: A first call with our Talent Acquisition team to discuss your background and expectations.

  • Manager Interview: Meet one of our Client Operations Team Lead, to dive deeper into the role's specifics.

  • Business Case: A practical exercise to evaluate your analytical skills and your approach to order-to-cash challenges.

  • Final Round: A concluding interview with Caroline Barbery-Mebrouk, CFO.

title: Account Executive, Commercial - Mexico
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This is a high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to small to medium size customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $5k to $20k, and typically involve proof of concepts, multiple stakeholders, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to owners, safety and operational managers.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Mexico. You will be selling over zoom and not in person.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close.
  • Generate pipeline through strategic outbound prospecting, as well as receive inbound leads from our account development team.
  • Target accounts with 11-30 vehicles.
  • Experience handling and owning transactional sales process with high volume demands.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • 1+ years of experience in a closing sales role

An ideal candidate has:

  • Proven track record of consistent quota achievement
  • Experience selling in the commercial space - small to medium deals sizes
  • Experience with high-volume cold calling
  • Experience in fast-paced, transactional sales
  • Must demonstrate a growth mindset and a willingness to be collaborative with your teammates and in your selling process
  • SFDC familiarity

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Identity and Numbering Analyst - Network API Registration
description:
Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

Vonage Communications APIs

Vonage helps businesses connect with their customers, employees and partners through communications APIs. Network APIs expose mobile-network capabilities through a consistent platform, enabling use cases such as identity verification, fraud reduction, location services and quality on demand.

Why this role matters

Network API access depends on accurate customer and application registrations, clear use-case information and approval by mobile network operators and other suppliers. As the senior operational lead for Network API registration, you will own the quality and flow of registration operations across supported countries: guiding cases from intake and validation through qualification hand-offs, supplier submission and status resolution.

You will be the escalation point for complex registration cases, establish consistent operational standards and work with customers, Sales, Customer Support, Product, Engineering and carrier partners. Your judgment and process improvements will help customers reach a clear next step while protecting compliance, data quality and supplier relationships.

Your key responsibilities

  • Lead Network API registration operations across assigned markets, prioritising cases and tracking them through to resolution.
  • Review business and application profiles for completeness and compliance with documented requirements; identify gaps and determine next steps.
  • Own complex-case escalations, document decisions and involve Compliance, Legal, Product or leadership when needed.
  • Coordinate Sales/SDR qualification hand-offs and once qualified submit accurate submissions to carriers, aggregators and suppliers.
  • Track supplier decisions and follow-ups resolve routine issues and escalate delays or recurring blockers.
  • Coordinate clear, accurate customer updates and information requests with Account Managers, API Support or Customer Solutions Engineering.
  • Set and maintain operational standards, procedures, country requirements and escalation guidance; mentor analysts and review work quality.
  • Report on volumes, turnaround, ageing, rework and rejection trends; lead practical process, tooling and automation improvements with cross-functional teams.

What you’ll bring

Required

  • 5+ years in telecoms, CPaaS, carrier operations, Network APIs, registration or related compliance operations.
  • Experience owning complex, multi-market workflows and working with carriers, aggregators, suppliers or enterprise customers.
  • Strong judgment reviewing business and application information, identifying gaps or risks, and documenting clear decisions.
  • Ability to lead through influence: set standards, mentor colleagues and improve quality without relying on formal authority.
  • Excellent communication and analytical skills; able to explain requirements clearly and use operational data to drive improvements.
  • A structured, detail-oriented approach and ability to work across regions and time zones.
  • Professional English proficiency and legal authorisation to work remotely from Spain.

Desirable

  • Network Registry or comparable operator registration experience; familiarity with CAMARA APIs, Mobile Connect, identity/fraud APIs, QoD or location services.
  • Experience with Salesforce/CRM, Jira, Confluence or similar workflow tools.
  • Experience improving API operations through tooling, automation, testing or service-readiness work.
  • Knowledge of international telecom compliance and data-handling requirements; additional European languages.

#LI-WW1

There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.

To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice.

Who we are:

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.
